name: Term level field
description: Field type for assigning terms with a level to an entity.

suggests.drupal:hal: Enables the TermLevelItemNormalizer so the level column is included in HAL+JSON output; the normalizer class extends a hal class and only loads when hal is present.

project_description: term_level provides a single Drupal field type, term_level, that stores a taxonomy term reference together with an integer level in one field item. It extends core's EntityReferenceItem, hard-defaulting the target entity type to taxonomy_term and adding a level column (unsigned int, indexed) alongside the target_id. The allowed levels are defined per field in the storage settings as newline-separated numeric-key|label pairs (for example 1|Beginner). The bundled widget (term_level_widget) extends the entity-reference autocomplete widget and adds a Level select built from those pairs; the bundled formatter (term_level_formatter) extends the entity-reference label formatter and appends the matching level label after the term label. An optional HAL normalizer adds the level value to serialized output when the hal module is installed. The module depends only on core taxonomy and ships config schema for the field storage/field/value settings.
